name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Snackbar-colored hints that slide in from any side on hover, keyboard focus or long-press.
improvements: Content is a React node, never HTML, fixing the XSS in Materialize's html option (CVE-2019-11002).
Opens on keyboard focus and touch long-press, closes on Escape, and is linked with aria-describedby.
Radix state handling prevents stuck tooltips (#3566); hovering the tooltip keeps it open.
Collision-aware positioning flips and shifts tooltips back into the viewport.
